# Authentication

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: basic

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer

<h1 id="spreed-full-avatar">avatar</h1>

## Get the avatar of a room

<a id="opIdavatar-get-avatar"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/room/string/avatar \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room/{token}/avatar`

<h3 id="get-the-avatar-of-a-room-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|darkTheme|query|boolean|false|Theme used for background|
|x-nextcloud-federation|header|string|false|Set to 1 when the request is performed by another Nextcloud Server to indicate a federation request|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|

<h3 id="get-the-avatar-of-a-room-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Room avatar returned|Inline|

<aside class="warning">
Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
bearer_auth, basic_auth
</aside>

## Set an emoji as avatar

<a id="opIdavatar-emoji-avatar"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/room/string/avatar/emoji \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "emoji": "string",
    "color": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room/{token}/avatar/emoji`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "emoji": "string",
  "color": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="set-an-emoji-as-avatar-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» emoji|body|string|true|Emoji|
|» color|body|string \| null|false|Color of the emoji|

<h3 id="get-the-dark-mode-avatar-of-a-room-parameters">Parameters</h3>

## Sends a new chat message to the given room

<a id="opIdbot-send-message"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/bot/string/message \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "message": "string",
    "referenceId": "",
    "replyTo": 0,
    "silent": false,
    "threadTitle": "",
    "threadId": 0
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/bot/{token}/message`

The author and timestamp are automatically set to the current user/guest and time.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "message": "string",
  "referenceId": "",
  "replyTo": 0,
  "silent": false,
  "threadTitle": "",
  "threadId": 0
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|Conversation token|
|x-nextcloud-talk-bot-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used together with the message to generate the SHA256-HMAC request signature|
|x-nextcloud-talk-bot-signature|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC signature over the concatenation of the random seed and the message, signed with the shared bot secret, to verify authenticity|

|body|body|object|true|none|
|» message|body|string|true|The message to send|
|» referenceId|body|string|false|For the message to be able to later identify it again|
|» replyTo|body|integer(int64)|false|Parent id which this message is a reply to|
|» silent|body|boolean|false|If sent silent the chat message will not create any notifications|
|» threadTitle|body|string|false|Only supported when not replying, when given will create a thread (requires `threads` capability)|
|» threadId|body|integer(int64)|false|Thread id which this message is a reply to without quoting a specific message (ignored when $replyTo is given, also requires `threads` capability)|

## Get the features that are enabled for the requesting bot

<a id="opIdbot-get-bot-features"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/bot/ask-features \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "token": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/bot/ask-features`

Allows bots to check which features an administrator has enabled for them, without requiring administrator credentials. The request is signed with the shared bot secret like all other bot requests: the signature is computed over the random seed and the conversation token sent in the request body, which is used to look the bot up. Keeping the token in the signed body binds the request to the conversation, so the signature headers on their own cannot be replayed.
Required capability: `bot-features-api`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "token": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="get-the-features-that-are-enabled-for-the-requesting-bot-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|x-nextcloud-talk-bot-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used together with the conversation token to generate the SHA256-HMAC request signature|
|x-nextcloud-talk-bot-signature|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC signature over the concatenation of the random seed and the conversation token, signed with the shared bot secret, to verify authenticity|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» token|body|string|true|Conversation token|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "ocs": {
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": {
      "features": 0
    }
  }
}
```

```json
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",

    },
    "data": null
  }
}
```

```json
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": null
  }
}
```

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/call/string \
```

<h1 id="spreed-full-chat">chat</h1>

## Receives chat messages from the given room

<a id="opIdchat-receive-messages"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/chat/string?lookIntoFuture=0' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/chat/{token}`

- Receiving the history ($lookIntoFuture=0): The next $limit messages after $lastKnownMessageId will be returned. The new $lastKnownMessageId for the follow up query is available as `X-Chat-Last-Given` header.
- Looking into the future ($lookIntoFuture=1): If there are currently no messages the response will not be sent immediately. Instead, HTTP connection will be kept open waiting for new messages to arrive and, when they do, then the response will be sent. The connection will not be kept open indefinitely, though; the number of seconds to wait for new messages to arrive can be set using the timeout parameter; the default timeout is 30 seconds, maximum timeout is 60 seconds. If the timeout ends a successful but empty response will be sent. If messages have been returned (status=200) the new $lastKnownMessageId for the follow up query is available as `X-Chat-Last-Given` header.
The limit specifies the maximum number of messages that will be returned, although the actual number of returned messages could be lower if some messages are not visible to the participant. Note that if none of the messages are visible to the participant the returned number of messages will be 0, yet the status will still be 200. Also note that `X-Chat-Last-Given` may reference a message not visible and thus not returned, but it should be used nevertheless as the $lastKnownMessageId for the follow-up query.

<h3 id="receives-chat-messages-from-the-given-room-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|lookIntoFuture|query|integer(int64)|true|Polling for new messages (1) or getting the history of the chat (0)|
|limit|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of chat messages to receive (100 by default, 200 at most)|
|lastKnownMessageId|query|integer(int64)|false|The last known message (serves as offset)|
|lastCommonReadId|query|integer(int64)|false|The last known common read message (so the response is 200 instead of 304 when it changes even when there are no messages)|
|timeout|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of seconds to wait for new messages (30 by default, 30 at most)|
|setReadMarker|query|integer(int64)|false|Automatically set the last read marker when 1, if your client does this itself via chat/{token}/read set to 0|
|includeLastKnown|query|integer(int64)|false|Include the $lastKnownMessageId in the messages when 1 (default 0)|
|noStatusUpdate|query|integer(int64)|false|When the user status should not be automatically set to online set to 1 (default 0)|
|markNotificationsAsRead|query|integer(int64)|false|Set to 0 when notifications should not be marked as read (default 1)|
|threadId|query|integer(int64)|false|Limit the chat message list to a given thread|
|x-nextcloud-federation|header|string|false|Set to 1 when the request is performed by another Nextcloud Server to indicate a federation request|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|
|lookIntoFuture|0|
|lookIntoFuture|1|
|setReadMarker|0|
|setReadMarker|1|
|includeLastKnown|0|
|includeLastKnown|1|
|noStatusUpdate|0|
|noStatusUpdate|1|
|markNotificationsAsRead|0|
|markNotificationsAsRead|1|

## Sends a new chat message to the given room

<a id="opIdchat-send-message"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/chat/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "message": "string",
    "actorDisplayName": "",
    "referenceId": "",
    "replyTo": 0,
    "replyToToken": "",
    "silent": false,
    "threadTitle": "",
    "threadId": 0
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/chat/{token}`

The author and timestamp are automatically set to the current user/guest and time.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "message": "string",
  "actorDisplayName": "",
  "referenceId": "",
  "replyTo": 0,
  "replyToToken": "",
  "silent": false,
  "threadTitle": "",
  "threadId": 0
}
```

<h3 id="sends-a-new-chat-message-to-the-given-room-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|x-nextcloud-federation|header|string|false|Set to 1 when the request is performed by another Nextcloud Server to indicate a federation request|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» message|body|string|true|the message to send|
|» actorDisplayName|body|string|false|for guests|
|» referenceId|body|string|false|for the message to be able to later identify it again|
|» replyTo|body|integer(int64)|false|Parent id which this message is a reply to|
|» replyToToken|body|string|false|Parent token to which reply is initiated|
|» silent|body|boolean|false|If sent silent the chat message will not create any notifications|
|» threadTitle|body|string|false|Only supported when not replying, when given will create a thread (requires `threads` capability)|
|» threadId|body|integer(int64)|false|Thread id which this message is a reply to without quoting a specific message (ignored when $replyTo is given, also requires `threads` capability)|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|

<h3 id="sends-a-new-chat-message-to-the-given-room-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Message sent successfully|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Sending message is not possible|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|When trying to cross reference wrongly on a reply-private, or the Matrix account of the user can not send to the Matrix room|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Actor not found|Inline|
|413|Payload Too Large|Message too long|Inline|
|429|Too Many Requests|Mention rate limit exceeded (guests only)|Inline|
|502|Bad Gateway|The Matrix homeserver rejected the message or could not be reached|Inline|

<h3 id="sends-a-new-chat-message-to-the-given-room-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ocs|object|true|none|none|
|» meta|[OCSMeta](#schemaocsmeta)|true|none|none|
|» data|object \| null|true|none|none|
|» » actorDisplayName|string|true|none|Display name of the message author (can be empty for type `deleted_users` and `guests`)|
|» » actorId|string|true|none|Actor id of the message author|
|» » actorType|string|true|none|See [Constants - Actor types of chat messages](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#actor-types-of-chat-messages)|
|» » expirationTimestamp|integer(int64)|true|none|Unix time stamp when the message expires and should be removed from the clients UI without further note or warning (only available with `message-expiration` capability)|
|» » message|string|true|none|Message string with placeholders (see [Rich Object String](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues/1706))|
|» » messageParameters|object|true|none|Message parameters for `message` (see [Rich Object String](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues/1706))|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|[RichObjectParameter](#schemarichobjectparameter)|false|none|none|
|» » messageType|string|true|none|Currently known types are `comment`, `comment_deleted`, `system` and `command`|
|» » systemMessage|string|true|none|Empty for normal chat message or the type of the system message (untranslated)|
|» » deleted|boolean|false|none|Set to `true` when the message was deleted|
|» » id|integer(int64)|true|none|ID of the comment|
|» » isReplyable|boolean|true|none|True if the user can post a reply to this message (only available with `chat-replies` capability)|
|» » markdown|boolean|true|none|Whether the message should be rendered as markdown or shown as plain text|
|» » reactions|object|true|none|An array map with relation between reaction emoji and total count of reactions with this emoji|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|» » reactionsSelf|[string]|false|none|When the user reacted this is the list of emojis the user reacted with|
|» » referenceId|string|true|none|A reference string that was given while posting the message to be able to identify a sent message again (only available with `chat-reference-id` capability). For grouped file uploads support, expected format is `{sha256(uploadId)}-{order}`, matching /^[a-f0-9]{60}-[0-9]{3}$/|
|» » timestamp|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp in seconds and UTC time zone|
|» » token|string|true|none|Conversation token|
|» » lastEditActorDisplayName|string|false|none|Display name of the last editing author (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » lastEditActorId|string|false|none|Actor id of the last editing author (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » lastEditActorType|string|false|none|Actor type of the last editing author - See [Constants - Actor types of chat messages](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#actor-types-of-chat-messages) (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » lastEditTimestamp|integer(int64)|false|none|Unix time stamp when the message was last edited (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » silent|boolean|false|none|Whether the message was sent silently (only available with `silent-send-state` capability)|
|» » threadId|integer(int64)|false|none|Thread ID if this message is part of a thread|
|» » isThread|boolean|false|none|Whether this message is the root of a thread|
|» » threadTitle|string|false|none|Title of the thread if this message is the root of a thread|
|» » threadReplies|integer(int64)|false|none|Number of replies in the thread if this message is the root of a thread|
|» » metaData|[ChatMessageMetaData](#schemachatmessagemetadata)|false|none|Additional metadata of the message|
|» » parent|[ChatMessage](#schemachatmessage) \| [DeletedChatMessage](#schemadeletedchatmessage)|false|none|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|[ChatMessage](#schemachatmessage)|false|none|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|[DeletedChatMessage](#schemadeletedchatmessage)|false|none|none|

## Schedules the sending of a new chat message to the given room

<a id="opIdchat-schedule-message"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/chat/string/schedule \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "message": "string",
    "sendAt": 0,
    "replyTo": 0,
    "silent": false,
    "threadTitle": "",
    "threadId": 0
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/chat/{token}/schedule`

The author and timestamp are automatically set to the current user and time.
Required capability: `scheduled-messages`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "message": "string",
  "sendAt": 0,
  "replyTo": 0,
  "silent": false,
  "threadTitle": "",
  "threadId": 0
}
```

<h3 id="schedules-the-sending-of-a-new-chat-message-to-the-given-room-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» message|body|string|true|The message to send|
|» sendAt|body|integer(int64)|true|When to send the scheduled message|
|» replyTo|body|integer(int64)|false|Parent id which this scheduled message is a reply to|
|» silent|body|boolean|false|If sent silent the scheduled message will not create any notifications when sent|
|» threadTitle|body|string|false|Only supported when not replying, when given will create a thread (requires `threads` capability)|
|» threadId|body|integer(int64)|false|Thread id without quoting a specific message (requires `threads` capability)|

|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|

## Sends a rich-object to the given room

<a id="opIdchat-share-object-to-chat"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/chat/string/share \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "objectType": "string",
    "objectId": "string",
    "metaData": "",
    "actorDisplayName": "",
    "referenceId": "",
    "threadId": 0
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/chat/{token}/share`

The author and timestamp are automatically set to the current user/guest and time.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "objectType": "string",
  "objectId": "string",
  "metaData": "",
  "actorDisplayName": "",
  "referenceId": "",
  "threadId": 0
}
```

<h3 id="sends-a-rich-object-to-the-given-room-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» objectType|body|string|true|Type of the object|
|» objectId|body|string|true|ID of the object|
|» metaData|body|string|false|Additional metadata, sample value: `{\"type\":\"geo-location\",\"id\":\"geo:52.5450511,13.3741463\",\"name\":\"Nextcloud Berlin Office\",\"latitude\":\"52.5450511\",\"longitude\":\"13.3741463\"}`|
|» actorDisplayName|body|string|false|Guest name|
|» referenceId|body|string|false|Reference ID|
|» threadId|body|integer(int64)|false|Thread id which this message is a reply to without quoting a specific message (also requires `threads` capability)|

<h3 id="sends-a-rich-object-to-the-given-room-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Object shared successfully|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Sharing object is not possible|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Actor not found|Inline|
|413|Payload Too Large|Message too long|Inline|

<h3 id="sends-a-rich-object-to-the-given-room-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ocs|object|true|none|none|
|» meta|[OCSMeta](#schemaocsmeta)|true|none|none|
|» data|object \| null|true|none|none|
|» » actorDisplayName|string|true|none|Display name of the message author (can be empty for type `deleted_users` and `guests`)|
|» » actorId|string|true|none|Actor id of the message author|
|» » actorType|string|true|none|See [Constants - Actor types of chat messages](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#actor-types-of-chat-messages)|
|» » expirationTimestamp|integer(int64)|true|none|Unix time stamp when the message expires and should be removed from the clients UI without further note or warning (only available with `message-expiration` capability)|
|» » message|string|true|none|Message string with placeholders (see [Rich Object String](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues/1706))|
|» » messageParameters|object|true|none|Message parameters for `message` (see [Rich Object String](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues/1706))|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|[RichObjectParameter](#schemarichobjectparameter)|false|none|none|
|» » messageType|string|true|none|Currently known types are `comment`, `comment_deleted`, `system` and `command`|
|» » systemMessage|string|true|none|Empty for normal chat message or the type of the system message (untranslated)|
|» » deleted|boolean|false|none|Set to `true` when the message was deleted|
|» » id|integer(int64)|true|none|ID of the comment|
|» » isReplyable|boolean|true|none|True if the user can post a reply to this message (only available with `chat-replies` capability)|
|» » markdown|boolean|true|none|Whether the message should be rendered as markdown or shown as plain text|
|» » reactions|object|true|none|An array map with relation between reaction emoji and total count of reactions with this emoji|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|» » reactionsSelf|[string]|false|none|When the user reacted this is the list of emojis the user reacted with|
|» » referenceId|string|true|none|A reference string that was given while posting the message to be able to identify a sent message again (only available with `chat-reference-id` capability). For grouped file uploads support, expected format is `{sha256(uploadId)}-{order}`, matching /^[a-f0-9]{60}-[0-9]{3}$/|
|» » timestamp|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp in seconds and UTC time zone|
|» » token|string|true|none|Conversation token|
|» » lastEditActorDisplayName|string|false|none|Display name of the last editing author (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » lastEditActorId|string|false|none|Actor id of the last editing author (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » lastEditActorType|string|false|none|Actor type of the last editing author - See [Constants - Actor types of chat messages](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#actor-types-of-chat-messages) (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » lastEditTimestamp|integer(int64)|false|none|Unix time stamp when the message was last edited (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » silent|boolean|false|none|Whether the message was sent silently (only available with `silent-send-state` capability)|
|» » threadId|integer(int64)|false|none|Thread ID if this message is part of a thread|
|» » isThread|boolean|false|none|Whether this message is the root of a thread|
|» » threadTitle|string|false|none|Title of the thread if this message is the root of a thread|
|» » threadReplies|integer(int64)|false|none|Number of replies in the thread if this message is the root of a thread|
|» » metaData|[ChatMessageMetaData](#schemachatmessagemetadata)|false|none|Additional metadata of the message|
|» » parent|[ChatMessage](#schemachatmessage) \| [DeletedChatMessage](#schemadeletedchatmessage)|false|none|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|[ChatMessage](#schemachatmessage)|false|none|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|[DeletedChatMessage](#schemadeletedchatmessage)|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» » deleted|true|

Status Code **400**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ocs|object|true|none|none|
|» meta|[OCSMeta](#schemaocsmeta)|true|none|none|
|» data|object|true|none|none|
|» » error|string|true|none|none|

Status Code **404**

|» data|object|true|none|none|

## Summarize the next bunch of chat messages from a given offset

<a id="opIdchat-summarize-chat"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/chat/string/summarize \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "fromMessageId": 1
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/chat/{token}/summarize`

Required capability: `chat-summary-api`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "fromMessageId": 1
}
```

<h3 id="summarize-the-next-bunch-of-chat-messages-from-a-given-offset-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» fromMessageId|body|integer(int64)|true|Offset from where on the summary should be generated|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "ocs": {
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": {
      "taskId": 0,
      "nextOffset": 0
    }
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "ocs": {
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": {
      "error": "ai-no-provider"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="summarize-the-next-bunch-of-chat-messages-from-a-given-offset-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Summary was scheduled, use the returned taskId to get the status information and output from the TaskProcessing API: [OCS TaskProcessing API](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/developer_manual/client_apis/OCS/ocs-taskprocessing-api.html#fetch-a-task-by-id). If the response data contains nextOffset, not all messages could be handled in a single request. After receiving the response a second summary should be requested with the provided nextOffset.|Inline|
|204|No Content|No messages found to summarize|None|
|400|Bad Request|The conversation is classified|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error||Inline|

<h3 id="summarize-the-next-bunch-of-chat-messages-from-a-given-offset-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ocs|object|true|none|none|
|» meta|[OCSMeta](#schemaocsmeta)|true|none|none|
|» data|object|true|none|none|
|» » taskId|integer(int64)|true|none|none|
|» » nextOffset|integer(int64)|false|none|none|

Status Code **400**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ocs|object|true|none|none|
|» meta|[OCSMeta](#schemaocsmeta)|true|none|none|
|» data|object|true|none|none|
|» » error|string|true|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» » error|ai-no-provider|
|» » error|ai-error|
|» » error|classified|

<aside class="warning">
Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
bearer_auth, basic_auth
</aside>

## Edit a chat message

<a id="opIdchat-edit-message"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/chat/string/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "message": "string"
```

<h3 id="edit-a-chat-message-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Message edited successfully|Inline|
|202|Accepted|Message edited successfully, but a bot or Matterbridge is configured, so the information can be replicated to other services|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Editing message is not possible, e.g. when the new message is empty or the message is too old|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Missing permissions to edit message|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Message not found|Inline|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Editing this message type is not allowed|Inline|
|413|Payload Too Large|Message too long|Inline|
|502|Bad Gateway|The Matrix homeserver rejected the edit or could not be reached|Inline|

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Message deleted successfully|Inline|
|202|Accepted|Message deleted successfully, but a bot or Matterbridge is configured, so the information can be replicated elsewhere|Inline|

|403|Forbidden|Missing permissions to delete message|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Message not found|Inline|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Deleting this message type is not allowed|Inline|
|502|Bad Gateway|The Matrix homeserver rejected the deletion or could not be reached|Inline|

```bash
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
```
```bash
    "lastReadMessage": null
```

<h3 id="pin-a-message-in-a-chat-as-a-moderator-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ocs|object|true|none|none|
|» meta|[OCSMeta](#schemaocsmeta)|true|none|none|
|» data|object \| null|true|none|none|
|» » actorDisplayName|string|true|none|Display name of the message author (can be empty for type `deleted_users` and `guests`)|
|» » actorId|string|true|none|Actor id of the message author|
|» » actorType|string|true|none|See [Constants - Actor types of chat messages](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#actor-types-of-chat-messages)|
|» » expirationTimestamp|integer(int64)|true|none|Unix time stamp when the message expires and should be removed from the clients UI without further note or warning (only available with `message-expiration` capability)|
|» » message|string|true|none|Message string with placeholders (see [Rich Object String](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues/1706))|
|» » messageParameters|object|true|none|Message parameters for `message` (see [Rich Object String](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues/1706))|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|[RichObjectParameter](#schemarichobjectparameter)|false|none|none|
|» » messageType|string|true|none|Currently known types are `comment`, `comment_deleted`, `system` and `command`|
|» » systemMessage|string|true|none|Empty for normal chat message or the type of the system message (untranslated)|
|» » deleted|boolean|false|none|Set to `true` when the message was deleted|
|» » id|integer(int64)|true|none|ID of the comment|
|» » isReplyable|boolean|true|none|True if the user can post a reply to this message (only available with `chat-replies` capability)|
|» » markdown|boolean|true|none|Whether the message should be rendered as markdown or shown as plain text|
|» » reactions|object|true|none|An array map with relation between reaction emoji and total count of reactions with this emoji|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|» » reactionsSelf|[string]|false|none|When the user reacted this is the list of emojis the user reacted with|
|» » referenceId|string|true|none|A reference string that was given while posting the message to be able to identify a sent message again (only available with `chat-reference-id` capability). For grouped file uploads support, expected format is `{sha256(uploadId)}-{order}`, matching /^[a-f0-9]{60}-[0-9]{3}$/|
|» » timestamp|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp in seconds and UTC time zone|
|» » token|string|true|none|Conversation token|
|» » lastEditActorDisplayName|string|false|none|Display name of the last editing author (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » lastEditActorId|string|false|none|Actor id of the last editing author (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » lastEditActorType|string|false|none|Actor type of the last editing author - See [Constants - Actor types of chat messages](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#actor-types-of-chat-messages) (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » lastEditTimestamp|integer(int64)|false|none|Unix time stamp when the message was last edited (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|» » silent|boolean|false|none|Whether the message was sent silently (only available with `silent-send-state` capability)|
|» » threadId|integer(int64)|false|none|Thread ID if this message is part of a thread|
|» » isThread|boolean|false|none|Whether this message is the root of a thread|
|» » threadTitle|string|false|none|Title of the thread if this message is the root of a thread|
|» » threadReplies|integer(int64)|false|none|Number of replies in the thread if this message is the root of a thread|
|» » metaData|[ChatMessageMetaData](#schemachatmessagemetadata)|false|none|Additional metadata of the message|
|» » parent|[ChatMessage](#schemachatmessage) \| [DeletedChatMessage](#schemadeletedchatmessage)|false|none|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|[ChatMessage](#schemachatmessage)|false|none|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|[DeletedChatMessage](#schemadeletedchatmessage)|false|none|none|

## Prepare the conversation attachment folder and probe filename conflicts

<a id="opIdchat-probe-attachment-folder"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/chat/string/attachment/folder \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "fileNames": [],
    "allowUpdate": false
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/chat/{token}/attachment/folder`

Creates the caller's conversation subfolder (and the room share) if not yet present, then creates or returns a Draft folder for staging uploads. Simulates the rename-on-conflict logic for each requested filename without requiring the files to already exist.
The returned `folder` is the Draft path — a staging area that is NOT shared with the room, so other participants cannot see in-progress uploads or files from aborted messages. Files are moved into the shared subfolder atomically when the attachment endpoint is called.
Recommended client flow: 1. Call this endpoint to obtain the Draft folder path and predicted final names. 2. Display the predicted names as accessibility placeholders immediately. 3. Upload each file to a random temporary name (e.g. a UUID) inside the returned Draft folder — do NOT upload to the predicted final name. 4. Call the attachment endpoint with the temp path as `filePath` and the original desired name as `fileName`. The server moves the file from Draft into the shared subfolder, resolves any conflicts, and posts the message.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "fileNames": [],
  "allowUpdate": false
}
```

<h3 id="prepare-the-conversation-attachment-folder-and-probe-filename-conflicts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» fileNames|body|[string]|false|Desired filenames to probe|
|» allowUpdate|body|boolean|false|Allow recipients to modify shared files|

## Post a file from the conversation Draft folder as a chat message

<a id="opIdchat-post-attachment-to-room"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/chat/string/attachment \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "filePath": "string",
    "referenceId": "string",
    "talkMetaData": "",
    "fileName": "",
    "allowUpdate": false
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/chat/{token}/attachment`

The file must be inside the Draft folder returned by the probe endpoint. This endpoint moves the file from Draft into the shared conversation subfolder (resolving any name conflicts), creates the chat message, and returns the actual final filename. The subfolder is shared with the room via a folder-level TYPE_ROOM share — no per-file share is created, keeping the Share Overview clean.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "filePath": "string",
  "referenceId": "string",
  "talkMetaData": "",
  "fileName": "",
  "allowUpdate": false
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|

|token|path|string|true|none|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» filePath|body|string|true|Path of the file relative to the user's home root (e.g. "Talk/Group Chat-abc123/Draft/uuid.jpg")|
|» referenceId|body|string|true|Client-generated reference ID for the message|
|» talkMetaData|body|string|false|JSON-encoded metadata (caption, messageType, silent, …)|
|» fileName|body|string|false|Desired final file name; the service resolves conflicts by appending " (1)", " (2)", … if already taken|
|» allowUpdate|body|boolean|false|Allow recipients to modify shared files|

<h1 id="spreed-full-filesintegration">files_integration</h1>

## Get the token of the room associated to the given file id

<a id="opIdfiles_integration-get-room-by-file-id"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/file/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/file/{fileId}`

This is the counterpart of self::getRoomByShareToken() for file ids instead of share tokens, although both return the same room token if the given file id and share token refer to the same file.
If there is no room associated to the given file id a new room is created; the new room is a public room associated with a "file" object with the given file id. Unlike normal rooms in which the owner is the user that created the room these are special rooms without owner (although self joined users with direct access to the file become persistent participants automatically when they join until they explicitly leave or no longer have access to the file).
In any case, to create or even get the token of the room, the file must be shared and the user must be the owner of a public share of the file (like a link share, for example) or have direct access to that file; an error is returned otherwise. A user has direct access to a file if they have access to it (or to an ancestor) through a user, group, circle or room share (but not through a link share, for example), or if they are the owner of such a file.

<h3 id="get-the-token-of-the-room-associated-to-the-given-file-id-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|fileId|path|string|true|ID of the file|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "ocs": {
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": {
      "token": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "ocs": {
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",

  }
}
```

## Returns the token of the room associated to the file of the given share token

<a id="opIdfiles_integration-get-room-by-share-token"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/publicshare/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/publicshare/{shareToken}`

This is the counterpart of self::getRoomByFileId() for share tokens instead of file ids, although both return the same room token if the given file id and share token refer to the same file.
If there is no room associated to the file id of the given share token a new room is created; the new room is a public room associated with a "file" object with the file id of the given share token. Unlike normal rooms in which the owner is the user that created the room these are special rooms without owner (although self joined users with direct access to the file become persistent participants automatically when they join until they explicitly leave or no longer have access to the file).
In any case, to create or even get the token of the room, the file must be publicly shared (like a link share, for example); an error is returned otherwise.
Besides the token of the room this also returns the current user ID and display name, if any; this is needed by the Talk sidebar to know the actual current user, as the public share page uses the incognito mode and thus logged-in users as seen as guests.

|shareToken|path|string|true|Token of the file share|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|

## Creates a new room for video verification (requesting the password of a share)

```bash
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/publicshareauth`

The new room is a public room associated with a "share:password" object with the ID of the share token. Unlike normal rooms in which the owner is the user that created the room these are special rooms always created by a guest or user on behalf of a registered user, the sharer, who will be the owner of the room.

`GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/live-transcription/translation-languages`

The returned array provides a list of origin languages ("originLanguages") and a list of target languages ("targetLanguages"). Any origin language can be translated to any target language.

## Set target language for live translations

<a id="opIdlive_transcription-set-target-language"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/live-transcription/string/target-language \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "targetLanguageId": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/live-transcription/{token}/target-language`

Each participant can set the language in which they want to receive the translations.
Setting the target language is possible only during a call and immediately enables the translations. Translations can be disabled by sending a null value as the language id.
translations are not supported.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "targetLanguageId": "string"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» targetLanguageId|body|string|true|the ID of the language to set|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|

<a id="opIdmatrix_account-get-account"></a>

```bash
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/matrix/account`

The access token of the linked account is checked with the homeserver, the result is reused for 5 minutes.

```json
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": {
      "canLink": true,
      "account": {
        "id": "string",
        "homeserverId": "string",
        "mxid": "string",
        "deviceId": "string",
        "status": 0,
        "lastError": "string",
        "lastSync": 0,
        "verified": true
      },
      "connected": true,
      "homeservers": [
        {
          "id": "string",
          "name": "string",
          "serverName": "string",
          "baseUrl": "string",
          "enabled": true,
          "specVersions": [
            "string"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "ocs": {
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": null
  }
}
```

## Verify the device of Talk with another device of the user

<a id="opIdmatrix_account-start-verification"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/matrix/account/verification \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/matrix/account/verification`

The other devices are asked to verify, the user accepts on one of them and compares the emoji. That device then cross-signs the device of Talk, so clients share the keys of encrypted rooms with it.

## Restore the keys of encrypted messages from the key backup of the Matrix account

<a id="opIdmatrix_account-restore-backup"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/matrix/account/backup \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "recoveryKey": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/matrix/account/backup`

The recovery key (security key) unlocks the key backup. The key of the backup is kept, so keys that are missing later are looked up in it.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "recoveryKey": "string"
}
```

```bash
  "maxVotes": 0,
```

<h1 id="spreed-full-preset">preset</h1>

## Get the list of available presets

<a id="opIdpreset-get-presets"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/presets/room \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/presets/room`

Required capability: `conversation-presets`
Presets come with 2 special presets: `forced` and `default`: - The default contains the before "presets" state by default, but administration can set different default values, which will then be preselected, but can still be changed by users. - If a parameter is listed in forced, the value will always be used, independent of the user selection or the value from the preset. So order of applying is: "default" preset > selected preset > user selection > "forced" preset

<h3 id="get-the-list-of-available-presets-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|

|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|

```json
{
  "ocs": {
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": [
      {
        "identifier": "string",
        "name": "string",
        "description": "string",
        "parameters": {
          "property1": 0,
          "property2": 0
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

```json
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",

      "message": "string",

    },
    "data": null
  }
}
```

## Request a temporary upload share for a recording

<a id="opIdrecording-request-upload"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/recording/string/request-upload \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "owner": "string",
    "fileName": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/recording/{token}/request-upload`

Creates a password-protected public link share with create-only permissions on the per-room recording folder, so the recording backend can upload a large recording via the chunked public WebDAV API.
Chunked uploading works the same way as it does for clients, documented in https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/developer_manual/client_apis/WebDAV/chunking.html#chunked-upload-v2
- Base URL: `public.php/dav/uploads/$SHARETOKEN` - HTTP user: share token - HTTP password: share password
After the upload and assembling is finished call the `/api/{apiVersion}/recording/{token}/store` endpoint {@see self::store()} and provide the file name, to trigger the notification for the moderator.
Required capability: `recording-chunked-upload`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "owner": "string",
  "fileName": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="request-a-temporary-upload-share-for-a-recording-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|talk-recording-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used together with the room token to generate the SHA256-HMAC request checksum|
|talk-recording-checksum|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC checksum over the concatenation of the random seed and the room token, signed with the shared recording secret, to verify authenticity from the recording backend|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» owner|body|string|true|User that will own the recording file.|
|» fileName|body|string|true|Suggested file name of the recording. The extension must be one of the allowed recording formats.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json

  "ocs": {
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": {
      "token": "string",
      "password": "string",
      "fileName": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

## Store the recording

<a id="opIdrecording-store"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v1/recording/string/store \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "owner": "string",
    "fileName": null
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/recording/{token}/store`

When a `fileName` is provided the recording is expected to have been uploaded already through a share requested with {@see self::requestUpload()}, and only the post-processing is run. Otherwise the recording is read from the multipart `file` upload.
Required capability: `recording-v1`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "owner": "string",
  "fileName": null
}
```

<h3 id="store-the-recording-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|talk-recording-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used together with the room token to generate the SHA256-HMAC request checksum|
|talk-recording-checksum|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC checksum over the concatenation of the random seed and the room token, signed with the shared recording secret, to verify authenticity from the recording backend|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» owner|body|string \| null|false|User that will own the recording file. `null` is actually not allowed and will always result in a "400 Bad Request". It's only allowed code-wise to handle requests where the post data exceeded the limits, so we can return a proper error instead of "500 Internal Server Error".|
|» fileName|body|string \| null|false|The sanitized file name returned by the request-upload request. When provided, no multipart `file` is expected.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v1|

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room`

With the `conversation-creation-all` capability a lot of new options where introduced. Before that only `$roomType`, `$roomName`, `$objectType` and `$objectId` were supported all the time, and `$password` with the `conversation-creation-password` capability In case the `$roomType` is {@see Room::TYPE_ONE_TO_ONE} only the `$invite` or `$participants` parameter is supported.
The endpoint can also be used unauthenticated by an external call service by signing the request with the configured shared secret via the `x-nextcloud-talk-external-service-random` and `x-nextcloud-talk-external-service-checksum` headers (SHA256-HMAC of the random seed and the `$owner` user ID).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "roomType": 0,
  "invite": "",
  "roomName": "",
  "source": "",
  "objectType": "",
  "objectId": "",
  "password": "",
  "readOnly": 0,
  "listable": 0,
  "messageExpiration": 0,
  "lobbyState": 0,
  "lobbyTimer": null,
  "sipEnabled": 0,
  "permissions": 0,
  "recordingConsent": 0,
  "mentionPermissions": 0,
  "description": "",
  "emoji": null,
  "avatarColor": null,
  "participants": {
    "users": [
      "string"
    ],
    "federated_users": [
      "string"
    ],
    "groups": [
      "string"
    ],
    "emails": [
      "string"
    ],
    "phones": [
      "string"
    ],
    "teams": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "owner": "",
  "preset": null
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-room-with-a-user-a-group-or-a-circle-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|x-nextcloud-talk-external-service-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used together with the owner user ID to generate the SHA256-HMAC request checksum|
|x-nextcloud-talk-external-service-checksum|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC checksum over the concatenation of the random seed and the owner user ID, signed with the shared external call service secret, to verify authenticity from the external call service|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» roomType|body|integer(int64)|false|Type of the room|
|» invite|body|string|false|**Deprecated.** User, group, … ID to invite Deprecated: Use the `$participants` array instead|
|» roomName|body|string|false|Name of the room, unless the legacy mode providing `$invite` and `$source` is used, the name must no longer be empty with the `conversation-creation-all` capability (Ignored if `$roomType` is {@see Room::TYPE_ONE_TO_ONE})|
|» source|body|string|false|**Deprecated.** Source of the invite ID ('circles' to create a room with a circle, etc.) Deprecated: Use the `$participants` array instead|
|» objectType|body|string|false|Type of the object (Ignored if `$roomType` is {@see Room::TYPE_ONE_TO_ONE})|
|» objectId|body|string|false|ID of the object (Ignored if `$roomType` is {@see Room::TYPE_ONE_TO_ONE})|
|» password|body|string|false|The room password (only available with `conversation-creation-password` capability) (Ignored if `$roomType` is not {@see Room::TYPE_PUBLIC})|
|» readOnly|body|integer(int64)|false|Read only state of the conversation (Default writable) (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» listable|body|integer(int64)|false|Scope where the conversation is listable (Default not listable for anyone) (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» messageExpiration|body|integer(int64)|false|Seconds after which messages will disappear, 0 disables expiration (Default 0) (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» lobbyState|body|integer(int64)|false|Lobby state of the conversation (Default lobby is disabled) (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» lobbyTimer|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|Timer when the lobby will be removed (Default null, will not be disabled automatically) (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» sipEnabled|body|integer(int64)|false|Whether SIP dial-in shall be enabled (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» permissions|body|integer(int64)|false|Default permissions for participants (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» recordingConsent|body|integer(int64)|false|Whether participants need to agree to a recording before joining a call (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» mentionPermissions|body|integer(int64)|false|Who can mention at-all in the chat (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» description|body|string|false|Description for the conversation (limited to 2.000 characters) (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» emoji|body|string \| null|false|Emoji for the avatar of the conversation (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» avatarColor|body|string \| null|false|Background color of the avatar (Only considered when an emoji was provided) (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» participants|body|[InvitationList](#schemainvitationlist)|false|List of participants to add grouped by type (only available with `conversation-creation-all` capability)|
|» owner|body|string|false|User ID that will be used as actor and made owner of the conversation. Required when the request is authenticated via the `x-nextcloud-talk-external-service-random` and `x-nextcloud-talk-external-service-checksum` headers, otherwise ignored.|
|» preset|body|string \| null|false|Identifier of the preset that was used (only available with `conversation-preset` capability)|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v4|
|» readOnly|0|
|» readOnly|1|
|» listable|0|
|» listable|1|
|» listable|2|
|» lobbyState|0|
|» lobbyState|1|
|» sipEnabled|0|
|» sipEnabled|1|
|» sipEnabled|2|
|» recordingConsent|0|
|» recordingConsent|1|
|» mentionPermissions|0|
|» mentionPermissions|1|

<h3 id="create-a-room-with-a-user-a-group-or-a-circle-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Room already existed|Inline|
|201|Created|Room created successfully|Inline|
|202|Accepted|Room created successfully but not all participants could be added|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Room type invalid or missing or invalid password|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Request not authenticated (missing user session or invalid external call service secret)|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Missing permissions to create room|Inline|
|404|Not Found|User, group or other target to invite was not found|Inline|

<h3 id="create-a-room-with-a-user-a-group-or-a-circle-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Get a room

<a id="opIdroom-get-single-room"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/room/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room/{token}`

<h3 id="get-a-room-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|Token of the room|
|x-nextcloud-federation|header|string|false|Set to 1 when the request is performed by another Nextcloud Server to indicate a federation request|
|talk-sipbridge-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used together with the room token to generate the SHA256-HMAC request checksum|
|talk-sipbridge-checksum|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC checksum over the concatenation of the random seed and the room token, signed with the shared SIP bridge secret, to verify authenticity from the SIP bridge|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|

## Synchronize the participants of a conversation with the given list

<a id="opIdroom-sync-participants"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/room/string/participants \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "participants": {
      "users": [
        "string"
      ],
      "federated_users": [
        "string"
      ],
      "groups": [
        "string"
      ],
      "emails": [
        "string"
      ],
      "phones": [
        "string"
      ],
      "teams": [
        "string"
      ]
    },
    "owner": ""
  }'
```

`PUT /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room/{token}/participants`

Only available for the external call service. Participants missing from the list are removed (except owners), participants new in the list are added.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "participants": {
    "users": [
      "string"
    ],
    "federated_users": [
      "string"
    ],
    "groups": [
      "string"
    ],
    "emails": [
      "string"
    ],
    "phones": [
      "string"
    ],
    "teams": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "owner": ""
}
```

<h3 id="synchronize-the-participants-of-a-conversation-with-the-given-list-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|Token of the room|
|x-nextcloud-talk-external-service-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used together with the owner user ID to generate the SHA256-HMAC request checksum|
|x-nextcloud-talk-external-service-checksum|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC checksum over the concatenation of the random seed and the owner user ID, signed with the shared external call service secret, to verify authenticity from the external call service|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» participants|body|[InvitationList](#schemainvitationlist)|false|List of participants the conversation should have grouped by type|
|» owner|body|string|false|User ID of an owner of the conversation that will be used as actor|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v4|

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/room/string/participants \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "newParticipant": "string",
    "source": "users"
  }'
```

<h3 id="add-a-participant-to-a-room-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Participant successfully added, in Matrix conversations the user is invited and added once they accepted|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Adding participant is not possible, e.g. when the user is banned or an email, phone number or federated user is added to a classified conversation (check error attribute of response for detail key)|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Current user is not logged in|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|The Matrix account of the user can not invite to the Matrix room|Inline|
|404|Not Found|User, group or other target to invite was not found|Inline|
|501|Not Implemented|SIP dial-out is not configured|Inline|
|502|Bad Gateway|The Matrix homeserver rejected the invite or could not be reached|Inline|

## Preserve a conversation

<a id="opIdroom-preserve-conversation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/room/string/preserve \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room/{token}/preserve`

While preserved the conversation can not be deleted, its chat history can not be cleared and the guests (public link) and joinable (listable) settings can not be changed.
Required capability: `preserve-conversation`

## Promote an attendee to moderator or owner

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/room/string/moderators \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "attendeeId": 0,
    "participantType": 0
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room/{token}/moderators`

Required capability: `promote-demote-owner` for `int $participantType`

## Import a list of email attendees

<a id="opIdroom-import-emails-as-participants"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/room/string/import-emails \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "testRun": false
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room/{token}/import-emails`

Content format is comma separated values: - Header line is required and must match `"email","name"` or `"email"` - One entry per line (e.g. `"John Doe","john@example.tld"`)
Required capability: `email-csv-import`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "testRun": false
}
```

<h3 id="import-a-list-of-email-attendees-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» testRun|body|boolean|false|When set to true, the file is validated and no email is actually sent nor any participant added to the conversation|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v4|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json

  "ocs": {
    "meta": {

    "data": {
      "invites": 0,
      "duplicates": 0,
      "invalid": 0,
      "invalidLines": [
        0
      ],
      "type": -1
    }
  }
}
```

```json
      "message": "string",
      "invites": 0,
      "duplicates": 0,
      "invalid": 0,
      "invalidLines": [
        0
      ],
      "type": -1
    }
  }
}
```

```json
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",

    },
    "data": null
  }
}
```

`GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room/{token}/capabilities`

## Schedule a meeting for a conversation

<a id="opIdroom-schedule-meeting"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/room/string/meeting \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "calendarUri": "string",
    "start": 0,
    "attendeeIds": null,
    "end": null,
    "title": null,
    "description": null
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room/{token}/meeting`

Required capability: `schedule-meeting`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "calendarUri": "string",
  "start": 0,
  "attendeeIds": null,
  "end": null,
  "title": null,
  "description": null
}
```

<h3 id="schedule-a-meeting-for-a-conversation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» calendarUri|body|string|true|Last part of the calendar URI as seen by the participant e.g. 'personal' or 'company_shared_by_other_user'|
|» start|body|integer(int64)|true|Unix timestamp when the meeting starts|
|» attendeeIds|body|[integer(int64)]|false|List of attendee ids to invite, if null everyone will be invited, if empty array only the actor will receive the event|
|» end|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|Unix timestamp when the meeting ends, falls back to 60 minutes after start|
|» title|body|string \| null|false|Title or summary of the event, falling back to the conversation name if none is given|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the event, falling back to the conversation description if none is given|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v4|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "ocs": {
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": null
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "ocs": {
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": {
      "error": "calendar"
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "ocs": {
    "meta": {
      "status": "string",
      "statuscode": 0,
      "message": "string",
      "totalitems": "string",
      "itemsperpage": "string"
    },
    "data": null
  }
}
```

<h3 id="schedule-a-meeting-for-a-conversation-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Meeting scheduled|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Meeting could not be created successfully|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Current user is not logged in|Inline|

## Direct dial-in (SIP bridge)

<a id="opIdroom-direct-dial-in"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/room/direct-dial-in \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  -d '{
    "phoneNumber": "string",
    "caller": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room/direct-dial-in`

Required capability: `sip-direct-dialin`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "phoneNumber": "string",
  "caller": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="direct-dial-in-sip-bridge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|talk-sipbridge-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used together with the phone number to generate the SHA256-HMAC request checksum|
|talk-sipbridge-checksum|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC checksum over the concatenation of the random seed and the phone number, signed with the shared SIP bridge secret, to verify authenticity from the SIP bridge|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» phoneNumber|body|string|true|Phone number that is called|
|» caller|body|string|true|Phone number of the person calling in|

```bash
    "options": {}
  }'
```

```bash
curl 'https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/room/string/rejected-dialout?callId=string' \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`DELETE /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/room/{token}/rejected-dialout`

<h3 id="reset-call-id-of-a-dial-out-participant-when-the-sip-gateway-rejected-it-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|callId|query|string|true|The call ID provided by the SIP bridge earlier to uniquely identify the call to terminate|
|options|query|string|false|Additional details to verify the validity of the request|
|talk-sipbridge-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used together with the room token to generate the SHA256-HMAC request checksum|
|talk-sipbridge-checksum|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC checksum over the concatenation of the random seed and the room token, signed with the shared SIP bridge secret, to verify authenticity from the SIP bridge|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|

## Get the signaling settings

<a id="opIdsignaling-get-settings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://cloud.example.com/ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v3/signaling/settings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/signaling/settings`

<h3 id="get-the-signaling-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|token|query|string|false|Token of the room|
|talk-recording-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used to generate the SHA256-HMAC request checksum|
|talk-recording-checksum|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC checksum over the random seed, signed with the shared recording secret, to verify authenticity from the recording backend|
|talk-sipbridge-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used together with the room token to generate the SHA256-HMAC request checksum|
|talk-sipbridge-checksum|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC checksum over the concatenation of the random seed and the room token, signed with the shared SIP bridge secret, to verify authenticity from the SIP bridge|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v3|

```json
            "string"
          ]
        }
      ],

        {
          "urls": [
            "string"
          ],

        }
      ],

}
```

```bash
  -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true'
```

`POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/{apiVersion}/signaling/backend`

See sections "Backend validation" in https://nextcloud-spreed-signaling.readthedocs.io/en/latest/standalone-signaling-api-v1/#backend-requests

<h3 id="backend-api-to-query-information-required-for-standalone-signaling-servers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiVersion|path|string|true|none|
|spreed-signaling-random|header|string|false|Random seed (at least 32 bytes) used together with the request body to generate the SHA256-HMAC request checksum|
|spreed-signaling-checksum|header|string|false|SHA256-HMAC checksum over the concatenation of the random seed and the request body, signed with the shared signaling secret, to verify authenticity from the signaling backend|
|OCS-APIRequest|header|boolean|true|Required to be true for the API request to pass|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|apiVersion|v3|

|pinnedAt|integer(int64)|false|none|Timestamp when the message was pinned - Required capability: `pinned-messages`|
|pinnedUntil|integer(int64)|false|none|Timestamp until when the message is pinned. If missing the message is pinned infinitely - Required capability: `pinned-messages`|
|threadId|integer(int64)|false|none|Set when a thread is created with this message. If missing, no thread creation is associated with this message|
|threadTitle|string|false|none|Set when a thread is created with this message. If missing, no thread creation is associated with this message|
|replyToMessageId|integer(int64)|false|none|Set only when a message in a convo is private replied on a 1-1 room. Represents the parent message id|
|replyToConversationToken|string|false|none|Set only when a message in a convo is private replied on a 1-1 room. Represents the parent message's group conversation token.|
|replyToConversationName|string|false|none|Set only when a message in a convo is private replied on a 1-1 room. Represents the parent message's group conversation name|
|replyToActorDisplayName|string|false|none|Set only when a message in a convo is private replied on a 1-1 room. Represents the parent message's actor display name|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
