|expirationTimestamp|integer(int64)|true|none|Unix time stamp when the message expires and should be removed from the clients UI without further note or warning (only available with `message-expiration` capability)|
|message|string|true|none|Message string with placeholders (see [Rich Object String](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues/1706))|
|messageParameters|object|true|none|Message parameters for `message` (see [Rich Object String](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues/1706))|
|messageType|string|true|none|Currently known types are `comment`, `comment_deleted`, `system` and `command`|
|systemMessage|string|true|none|Empty for normal chat message or the type of the system message (untranslated)|
|deleted|boolean|false|none|Set to `true` when the message was deleted|
|id|integer(int64)|true|none|ID of the comment|
|isReplyable|boolean|true|none|True if the user can post a reply to this message (only available with `chat-replies` capability)|
|markdown|boolean|true|none|Whether the message should be rendered as markdown or shown as plain text|
|reactions|object|true|none|An array map with relation between reaction emoji and total count of reactions with this emoji|
|reactionsSelf|[string]|false|none|When the user reacted this is the list of emojis the user reacted with|
|referenceId|string|true|none|A reference string that was given while posting the message to be able to identify a sent message again (only available with `chat-reference-id` capability). For grouped file uploads support, expected format is `{sha256(uploadId)}-{order}`, matching /^[a-f0-9]{60}-[0-9]{3}$/|
|timestamp|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp in seconds and UTC time zone|
|token|string|true|none|Conversation token|
|lastEditActorDisplayName|string|false|none|Display name of the last editing author (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|lastEditActorId|string|false|none|Actor id of the last editing author (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|lastEditActorType|string|false|none|Actor type of the last editing author - See [Constants - Actor types of chat messages](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#actor-types-of-chat-messages) (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|lastEditTimestamp|integer(int64)|false|none|Unix time stamp when the message was last edited (only available with `edit-messages` capability and when the message was actually edited)|
|silent|boolean|false|none|Whether the message was sent silently (only available with `silent-send-state` capability)|
|threadId|integer(int64)|false|none|Thread ID if this message is part of a thread|
|isThread|boolean|false|none|Whether this message is the root of a thread|
|threadTitle|string|false|none|Title of the thread if this message is the root of a thread|
|threadReplies|integer(int64)|false|none|Number of replies in the thread if this message is the root of a thread|
|metaData|[ChatMessageMetaData](#schemachatmessagemetadata)|false|none|Additional metadata of the message|
|parent|[ChatMessage](#schemachatmessage) \| [DeletedChatMessage](#schemadeletedchatmessage)|false|none|none|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|deleted|true|

```json
{

  "actorType": "string",

  "attendeePermissions": 0,
  "attendeePin": "string",
  "displayName": "string",
  "inCall": 0,
  "lastPing": 0,

  "sessionIds": [
    "string"
  ],

  "phoneNumber": "string",
  "callId": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|actorId|string|true|none|The unique identifier for the given actor type|
|invitedActorId|string|false|none|The cloud id of the invited user|
|actorType|string|true|none|Currently known `users\|guests\|emails\|groups\|circles` (see [Constants - Attendee types](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#attendee-types))|
|attendeeId|integer(int64)|true|none|Unique attendee id|
|attendeePermissions|integer(int64)|true|none|Dedicated permissions for the current participant, if not `Custom` this are not the resulting permissions (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#attendee-permissions))|
|attendeePin|string|true|none|Unique dial-in authentication code for this user, when the conversation has SIP enabled (see `sipEnabled` attribute)|
|displayName|string|true|none|Can be empty for guests|
|inCall|integer(int64)|true|none|Call flags the user joined with (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#participant-in-call-flag))|
|lastPing|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp of the last ping of the user (should be used for sorting)|
|participantType|integer(int64)|true|none|Permissions level of the participant (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#participant-types))|
|permissions|integer(int64)|true|none|Combined final permissions for the participant, permissions are picked in order of attendee then call then default and the first which is `Custom` will apply (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#attendee-permissions))|
|roomToken|string|true|none|Only available with `breakout-rooms-v1` capability|
|sessionIds|[string]|true|none|Array of session ids, each are up to 512 character long strings, or empty if no session|
|actorAvatarVersion|string|false|none|Version of the actor's avatar, only for users. Passing it to the avatar endpoint allows a much longer cache lifetime|
|status|string|false|none|Only available with `includeStatus=true`, for users with a set status and when there are less than 100 participants in the conversation|
|statusClearAt|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|Only available with `includeStatus=true`, for users with a set status and when there are less than 100 participants in the conversation|
|statusIcon|string \| null|false|none|Only available with `includeStatus=true`, for users with a set status and when there are less than 100 participants in the conversation|
|statusMessage|string \| null|false|none|Only available with `includeStatus=true`, for users with a set status and when there are less than 100 participants in the conversation|
|phoneNumber|string \| null|false|none|Only available with `sip-support-dialout` capability and only filled for moderators that are allowed to configure SIP for conversations|
|callId|string \| null|false|none|Only available with `sip-support-dialout` capability and only filled for moderators that are allowed to configure SIP for conversations|

|preview-available|string|false|none|Whether a preview is available for the file|
|hide-download|string|false|none|Whether the download should be hidden for the file|
|mtime|string|false|none|Modification time of the file as UNIX timestamp|
|latitude|string|false|none|Latitude of a location|
|longitude|string|false|none|Longitude of a location|
|description|string|false|none|Description of the object|
|thumb|string|false|none|URL of a thumbnail|
|website|string|false|none|Website URL|
|visibility|string|false|none|Visibility of the object|
|assignable|string|false|none|Whether the object is assignable|
|conversation|string|false|none|Conversation token|
|etag|string|false|none|ETag of the object for caching|
|permissions|string|false|none|Permissions for the file|
|width|string|false|none|Width of the object (e.g. image, video)|
|height|string|false|none|Height of the object (e.g. image, video)|
|blurhash|string|false|none|Blurhash of the image|

|call-type|group|
|call-type|public|

|hide-download|no|
|visibility|0|
|visibility|1|
|assignable|0|
|assignable|1|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|actorId|string|true|none|The unique identifier for the given actor type|
|invitedActorId|string|false|none|The cloud id of the invited user|
|actorType|string|true|none|Actor type of the current user (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#attendee-types))|
|attendeeId|integer(int64)|true|none|Unique attendee id|
|attendeePermissions|integer(int64)|true|none|Dedicated permissions for the current participant, if not `Custom` this are not the resulting permissions (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#attendee-permissions))|
|attendeePin|string \| null|true|none|Unique dial-in authentication code for this user, when the conversation has SIP enabled (see `sipEnabled` attribute)|
|avatarVersion|string|true|none|Version of conversation avatar used to easier expiration of the avatar in case a moderator updates it, since the avatar endpoint should be cached for 24 hours. (only available with `avatar` capability)|
|breakoutRoomMode|integer(int64)|true|none|Breakout room configuration mode (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#breakout-room-modes)) (only available with `breakout-rooms-v1` capability)|
|breakoutRoomStatus|integer(int64)|true|none|Breakout room status (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#breakout-room-status)) (only available with `breakout-rooms-v1` capability)|
|callFlag|integer(int64)|true|none|Combined flag of all participants in the current call (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#participant-in-call-flag), only available with `conversation-call-flags` capability)|
|callPermissions|integer(int64)|true|none|Call permissions, if not `Custom` this are not the resulting permissions, if set they will reset after the end of the call (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#attendee-permissions))|
|callRecording|integer(int64)|true|none|Type of call recording (see [Constants - Call recording status](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#call-recording-status)) (only available with `recording-v1` capability)|
|callStartTime|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp when the call was started (only available with `recording-v1` capability)|
|canDeleteConversation|boolean|true|none|Flag if the user can delete the conversation for everyone (not possible without moderator permissions or in one-to-one conversations)|
|canEnableSIP|boolean|true|none|Whether the given user can enable SIP for this conversation. Note that when the token is not-numeric only, SIP can not be enabled even if the user is permitted and a moderator of the conversation|
|canLeaveConversation|boolean|true|none|Flag if the user can leave the conversation (not possible for the last user with moderator permissions)|
|canStartCall|boolean|true|none|Flag if the user can start a new call in this conversation (joining is always possible) (only available with `start-call-flag` capability)|
|defaultPermissions|integer(int64)|true|none|Default permissions for new participants (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#attendee-permissions))|
|description|string|true|none|Description of the conversation (can also be empty) (only available with `room-description` capability)|
|displayName|string|true|none|`name` if non-empty, otherwise it falls back to a list of participants|
|hasCall|boolean|true|none|Flag if the conversation has an active call|
|hasPassword|boolean|true|none|Flag if the conversation has a password|
|id|integer(int64)|true|none|Identifier of the conversation|
|isCustomAvatar|boolean|true|none|Flag if the conversation has a custom avatar (only available with `avatar` capability)|
|isFavorite|boolean|true|none|Flag if the conversation is favorited by the user|
|lastActivity|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp of the last activity in the conversation, in seconds and UTC time zone|
|lastCommonReadMessage|integer(int64)|true|none|ID of the last message read by every user that has read privacy set to public in a room. When the user themself has it set to private the value is `0` (only available with `chat-read-status` capability)|
|lastMessage|[RoomLastMessage](#schemaroomlastmessage)|false|none|Last message in a conversation if available, otherwise empty. **Note:** Even when given the message will not contain the `parent` or `reactionsSelf` attribute due to performance reasons|
|lastPing|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp of the user's session making the request|
|lastReadMessage|integer(int64)|true|none|ID of the last read message in a room (only available with `chat-read-marker` capability)|
|listable|integer(int64)|true|none|Listable scope for the room (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#listable-scope)) (only available with `listable-rooms` capability)|
|liveTranscriptionLanguageId|string|true|none|ID of the language to use for live transcriptions in the room,|
|lobbyState|integer(int64)|true|none|Webinar lobby restriction (0-1), if the participant is a moderator they can always join the conversation (only available with `webinary-lobby` capability) (See [Webinar lobby states](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#webinar-lobby-states))|
|lobbyTimer|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp when the lobby will be automatically disabled (only available with `webinary-lobby` capability)|
|mentionPermissions|integer(int64)|true|none|Whether all participants can mention using `@all` or only moderators (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#mention-permissions)) (only available with `mention-permissions` capability)|
|messageExpiration|integer(int64)|true|none|The message expiration time in seconds in this chat. Zero if disabled. (only available with `message-expiration` capability)|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the conversation (can also be empty)|
|notificationCalls|integer(int64)|true|none|The call notification level for the user (see [Participant call notification levels](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#participant-call-notification-levels))|
|notificationLevel|integer(int64)|true|none|The notification level for the user (See [Participant notification levels](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#participant-notification-levels))|
|objectId|string|true|none|See [Object types](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#object-types) documentation for explanation|
|objectType|string|true|none|The type of object that the conversation is associated with (See [Object types](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#object-types))|
|participantFlags|integer(int64)|true|none|"In call" flags of the user's session making the request (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#participant-in-call-flag)) (only available with `in-call-flags` capability)|
|participantType|integer(int64)|true|none|Permissions level of the current user (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#participant-types))|
|permissions|integer(int64)|true|none|Combined final permissions for the current participant, permissions are picked in order of attendee then call then default and the first which is `Custom` will apply (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#attendee-permissions))|
|readOnly|integer(int64)|true|none|Read-only state for the current user (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#read-only-states)) (only available with `read-only-rooms` capability)|
|recordingConsent|integer(int64)|true|none|Whether recording consent is required before joining a call (Only 0 and 1 will be returned, see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#recording-consent-required)) (only available with `recording-consent` capability)|
|remoteServer|string|false|none|none|
|remoteToken|string|false|none|none|
|sessionId|string|true|none|`'0'` if not connected, otherwise an up to 512 character long string that is the identifier of the user's session making the request. Should only be used to pre-check if the user joined already with this session, but this might be outdated by the time of usage, so better check via [Get list of participants in a conversation](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/participant/#get-list-of-participants-in-a-conversation)|
|sipEnabled|integer(int64)|true|none|SIP enable status (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#sip-states))|
|status|string|false|none|Only available for one-to-one conversations, when `includeStatus=true` is set and the user has a status|
|statusClearAt|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|Only available for one-to-one conversations, when `includeStatus=true` is set and the user has a status, can still be null even with a status|
|statusIcon|string \| null|false|none|Only available for one-to-one conversations, when `includeStatus=true` is set and the user has a status, can still be null even with a status|
|statusMessage|string \| null|false|none|Only available for one-to-one conversations, when `includeStatus=true` is set and the user has a status, can still be null even with a status|
|token|string|true|none|Token identifier of the conversation which is used for further interaction|
|type|integer(int64)|true|none|See list of conversation types in the [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants/#conversation-types)|
|unreadMention|boolean|true|none|Flag if the user was mentioned since their last visit|
|unreadMentionDirect|boolean|true|none|Flag if the user was mentioned directly (ignoring `@all` mentions) since their last visit (only available with `direct-mention-flag` capability)|
|unreadMessages|integer(int64)|true|none|Number of unread chat messages in the conversation (only available with `chat-v2` capability)|
|isArchived|boolean|true|none|Flag if the conversation is archived by the user (only available with `archived-conversations-v2` capability)|
|isImportant|boolean|true|none|Required capability: `important-conversations`|
|isSensitive|boolean|true|none|Required capability: `sensitive-conversations`|
|tagIds|[string]|true|none|IDs of the custom tags this conversation is marked with (only available with `conversation-tags` capability)|
|lastPinnedId|integer(int64)|true|none|Required capability: `pinned-messages`|
|hiddenPinnedId|integer(int64)|true|none|Required capability: `pinned-messages`|
|hasScheduledMessages|integer(int64)|true|none|Required capability: `scheduled-messages` (local)|
|attributes|integer(int64)|true|none|Bit-flag of enabled attributes of this conversation (only available with capability: `conversation-attributes`). See [attributes list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants/#conversation-attributes) for details|

|callRecording|1|
|callRecording|2|
|callRecording|3|
|callRecording|4|
|callRecording|5|
|mentionPermissions|0|
|mentionPermissions|1|

|canLeaveConversation|boolean|true|none|Flag if the user can leave the conversation (not possible for the last user with moderator permissions)|

|lastCommonReadMessage|integer(int64)|true|none|ID of the last message read by every user that has read privacy set to public in a room. When the user themself has it set to private the value is `0` (only available with `chat-read-status` capability)|
|lastMessage|[RoomLastMessage](#schemaroomlastmessage)|false|none|Last message in a conversation if available, otherwise empty. **Note:** Even when given the message will not contain the `parent` or `reactionsSelf` attribute due to performance reasons|

|lastReadMessage|integer(int64)|true|none|ID of the last read message in a room (only available with `chat-read-marker` capability)|

|liveTranscriptionLanguageId|string|true|none|ID of the language to use for live transcriptions in the room,|
|lobbyState|integer(int64)|true|none|Webinar lobby restriction (0-1), if the participant is a moderator they can always join the conversation (only available with `webinary-lobby` capability) (See [Webinar lobby states](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#webinar-lobby-states))|
|lobbyTimer|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp when the lobby will be automatically disabled (only available with `webinary-lobby` capability)|
|mentionPermissions|integer(int64)|true|none|Whether all participants can mention using `@all` or only moderators (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#mention-permissions)) (only available with `mention-permissions` capability)|
|messageExpiration|integer(int64)|true|none|The message expiration time in seconds in this chat. Zero if disabled. (only available with `message-expiration` capability)|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the conversation (can also be empty)|
|notificationCalls|integer(int64)|true|none|The call notification level for the user (see [Participant call notification levels](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#participant-call-notification-levels))|
|notificationLevel|integer(int64)|true|none|The notification level for the user (See [Participant notification levels](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#participant-notification-levels))|
|objectId|string|true|none|See [Object types](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#object-types) documentation for explanation|
|objectType|string|true|none|The type of object that the conversation is associated with (See [Object types](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#object-types))|
|participantFlags|integer(int64)|true|none|"In call" flags of the user's session making the request (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#participant-in-call-flag)) (only available with `in-call-flags` capability)|
|participantType|integer(int64)|true|none|Permissions level of the current user (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#participant-types))|
|permissions|integer(int64)|true|none|Combined final permissions for the current participant, permissions are picked in order of attendee then call then default and the first which is `Custom` will apply (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#attendee-permissions))|
|readOnly|integer(int64)|true|none|Read-only state for the current user (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#read-only-states)) (only available with `read-only-rooms` capability)|
|recordingConsent|integer(int64)|true|none|Whether recording consent is required before joining a call (Only 0 and 1 will be returned, see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#recording-consent-required)) (only available with `recording-consent` capability)|
|remoteServer|string|false|none|none|
|remoteToken|string|false|none|none|
|sessionId|string|true|none|`'0'` if not connected, otherwise an up to 512 character long string that is the identifier of the user's session making the request. Should only be used to pre-check if the user joined already with this session, but this might be outdated by the time of usage, so better check via [Get list of participants in a conversation](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/participant/#get-list-of-participants-in-a-conversation)|
|sipEnabled|integer(int64)|true|none|SIP enable status (see [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants#sip-states))|
|status|string|false|none|Only available for one-to-one conversations, when `includeStatus=true` is set and the user has a status|
|statusClearAt|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|Only available for one-to-one conversations, when `includeStatus=true` is set and the user has a status, can still be null even with a status|
|statusIcon|string \| null|false|none|Only available for one-to-one conversations, when `includeStatus=true` is set and the user has a status, can still be null even with a status|
|statusMessage|string \| null|false|none|Only available for one-to-one conversations, when `includeStatus=true` is set and the user has a status, can still be null even with a status|
|token|string|true|none|Token identifier of the conversation which is used for further interaction|
|type|integer(int64)|true|none|See list of conversation types in the [constants list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants/#conversation-types)|
|unreadMention|boolean|true|none|Flag if the user was mentioned since their last visit|
|unreadMentionDirect|boolean|true|none|Flag if the user was mentioned directly (ignoring `@all` mentions) since their last visit (only available with `direct-mention-flag` capability)|
|unreadMessages|integer(int64)|true|none|Number of unread chat messages in the conversation (only available with `chat-v2` capability)|
|isArchived|boolean|true|none|Flag if the conversation is archived by the user (only available with `archived-conversations-v2` capability)|
|isImportant|boolean|true|none|Required capability: `important-conversations`|
|isSensitive|boolean|true|none|Required capability: `sensitive-conversations`|
|tagIds|[string]|true|none|IDs of the custom tags this conversation is marked with (only available with `conversation-tags` capability)|
|lastPinnedId|integer(int64)|true|none|Required capability: `pinned-messages`|
|hiddenPinnedId|integer(int64)|true|none|Required capability: `pinned-messages`|
|hasScheduledMessages|integer(int64)|true|none|Required capability: `scheduled-messages` (local)|
|attributes|integer(int64)|true|none|Bit-flag of enabled attributes of this conversation (only available with capability: `conversation-attributes`). See [attributes list](https://nextcloud-talk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/constants/#conversation-attributes) for details|
|invalidParticipants|[InvitationList](#schemainvitationlist)|true|none|List of participants that could not be invited grouped by source type|
